name: Kieta Memory – The Girl from the Stars
source:
It's the year 1992. Life is full of wonderful miracles. Without those you would never have met your beloved girlfriend, Azuki. A very special girl, a girl from the stars... Together with Azuki you discover the strange world of a normal star human family. You get to know her energetic little sister, her mysterious parents and her snappy house robot, Marvin. A bright and infinite future lies ahead of you, but then the summer of love and happiness comes to an abrupt end. 

The start into an adventure through time and space. Conspiracies and political plots which end your young love will ultimately decide about the fate of Earth. 

Together with your friends you will face this adventure and choose your path. A path that might bring you new love. 

You can't change the past, but you can change the future!

[From [url=https://thelastsecret.itch.io/kieta-memory]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1992年，生活充满了奇妙的奇迹。没有这些，你永远不会遇到你心爱的女朋友小豆。一个非常特别的女孩，一个来自星星的女孩……和小豆一起，你发现了一个普通星际人类家庭的奇怪世界。你会认识她精力充沛的妹妹、她神秘的父母和她活泼的家庭机器人马文。光明无限的未来就在前方，但爱情与幸福的夏天却戛然而止。

穿越时空的冒险开始。结束你们年轻爱情的阴谋和政治阴谋将最终决定地球的命运。

你将与​​你的朋友一起面对这次冒险并选择你的道路。一条可能会给你带来新爱情的道路。

你无法改变过去，但你可以改变未来！

[来自[url=https://thelastsecret.itch.io/kieta-memory]itch.io[/url]]
